record.original_question: For the longest increasing subsequence problem, can one prove KPZ-class fluctuation results when the permutation is sampled from distributions more general than the uniform distribution?

evidence.quote: Also, regarding the original longest increasing subsequence problem, KPZ universality for the fluctuations has been proved so far only for the uniform distribution on the permutations: The problem for the fluctuations with more general distributions is very much open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S_n$ denote the symmetric group on $\{1,2,\dots,n\}$, and for a permutation $\pi\in S_n$ let $L_n(\pi)$ denote the length of the longest increasing subsequence of $\pi$. When $\pi$ is sampled uniformly at random from $S_n$, it is known (Baik–Deift–Johansson) that
$$\frac{L_n - 2\sqrt{n}}{n^{1/6}} \xrightarrow{d} F_2,$$
where $F_2$ is the GUE Tracy–Widom distribution, placing the model in the Kardar–Parisi–Zhang (KPZ) universality class.

Problem. Identify natural families of probability measures $\{\mu_n\}$ on $S_n$ that differ from the uniform measure, and prove KPZ-class fluctuation theorems for $L_n$ under $\pi\sim\mu_n$: that is, find deterministic centering $a_n$ and scaling $b_n$ (with $b_n$ of KPZ-type order, e.g. a power of $n$ less than $1/2$) such that
$$\frac{L_n - a_n}{b_n} \xrightarrow{d} \mathcal{D}$$
for a KPZ-universality limiting law $\mathcal{D}$ (such as the Tracy–Widom $F_1$, $F_2$, or $F_4$ distribution, or related Airy-type distributions). Determine the broadest class of non-uniform distributions on $S_n$ for which such KPZ-type fluctuation results hold.
artifact.category_tag: KPZ universality and longest increasing subsequences
artifact.status_search_result: For the uniform distribution, KPZ/Tracy–Widom fluctuations are classical (Baik–Deift–Johansson, 1999), and the scaling limit of the LIS as a path has been identified (Dauvergne, 2021). For non-uniform models, partial results exist: under the Mallows measure with parameter $q\in(0,1)$ regimes, Gaussian (non-KPZ) fluctuations have been established (Bhatnagar–Peled, Mueller–Starr, Basu–Bhatnagar). KPZ-type fluctuations beyond the uniform case remain largely unestablished in general, so the broader question is considered partially solved / still open.

status_evidence.title: Limit theorems for longest monotone subsequences in random Mallows permutations
status_evidence.snippet: Limit theorems for the longest increasing subsequence under Mallows measure; Gaussian fluctuations in certain regimes.
status_evidence.claim: Non-uniform (Mallows) case yields Gaussian rather than Tracy–Widom fluctuations, indicating partial progress beyond the uniform setting.

status_evidence.title: The scaling limit of the longest increasing subsequence
status_evidence.snippet: Scaling limit of the LIS in a uniform random permutation is a geodesic in the directed landscape.
status_evidence.claim: KPZ-class scaling limit established for the uniform distribution.

status_evidence.title: KPZ limit theorems (J. Baik, ICM)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of KPZ limit theorems, including LIS for uniform permutations.
status_evidence.claim: KPZ universality for LIS is established for uniform measure; extensions to broader distributions are not standard.
